added: **Choose the backup:** Original pictures asks whether to keep a backup copy of each original or just shrink, once it is added and again after this update. Nothing is shrunk until you choose; a backup you already have is kept.

**Start again** in its actions, for the pictures it shrinks or for every picture: deletes the backup and the records, and has Jellyfin download the pictures again at full size. A picture Jellyfin cannot download again is put back after a day.

**Every picture type:** posters, photos of people, backdrops, thumbnails, logos, banners, disc art and clear art, each with its own size and all activated, with **Shrink all picture types** for all in one setting. Backdrops asked for by Lentzeris (issue #2).
changed: **Rules 1.2:** the same rules file as the Jellyfin version (SYNC.md).
**Settings in sections:** What to shrink (with Original pictures), Sizes and quality, and When it runs. After this update, check What to shrink: every type is shrunk until you choose otherwise.
removed: **Back up each original before it is replaced:** replaced by Original pictures.

changed: **Lighter at rest:** it wakes about once a minute while nothing asks it anything, not twice a second.
**Starts faster:** its image comes with Python's modules already compiled, so a start takes about a quarter of the processor time.

added: **Backup first:** each original is copied to the plug-in's own folder before its first shrink, and a picture whose original cannot be backed up is not shrunk. Activated by default.
**Restore original pictures** and **Delete backup** in its actions; Space saved shows the pictures now, the backup and the space saved.
**Quality, posters and photos of people** are settings, as in the Jellyfin version.
**Stays idle when Jellyfin's own Picture shrinker is installed**, so the two never shrink the same pictures. To see that, it reads Jellyfin's list of plug-ins with Jellyfin's key.
changed: **Rules 1.1:** the same rules file as the Jellyfin version (SYNC.md).
**Quiet when it finishes:** a run changes only the figures on its card and page; the card no longer shows a problem status.

added: **Shrinks Jellyfin's pictures:** posters to 900 pixels tall and photos of cast and crew to 400 pixels wide, both settings. Smaller pictures are left alone.
**Checked before it replaces:** each picture is written beside the original, opened again and checked, and swapped in only when it is smaller.
**When you choose:** every day, week or month at a time, with Shrink now, at the lowest priority.
**New pictures in quiet hours:** deactivated unless you activate it.
**Space saved:** on its page and on a dashboard card.
